$comment: PDLC system - annotated settings template. This repo is ~/.claude; scripts resolve under ${HOME}/.claude/scripts. The live file is settings.json. Verified opt-in keys (exact syntax per code.claude.com/docs/en/settings): fallbackModel (array of model-ids tried in order on overload); skillOverrides ({"<skill>": "on|name-only|user-invocable-only|off"}); disableSkillShellExecution (boolean, blocks inline shell in skills/commands/plugins); autoMemoryDirectory (absolute or ~/-prefixed path). requiredMinimumVersion/requiredMaximumVersion are managed-settings-only, not user settings. Docs: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/settings MODEL: `model` must be a STRING (an object fails validation); aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable) track the latest model and avoid pinning to a superseded generation. HOOKS: `$comment` is NOT valid inside `hooks` - every key there is parsed as a hook event name and an unknown one is silently ignored, so the hooks explanation lives here instead: Hooks live in ~/.claude/scripts/ and are referenced by absolute ${HOME} path so they resolve from any working project. verify-artifact-hook.sh is the layer-6 pre-output gate (standards/ANTI_HALLUCINATION.md) wired at the tool boundary: it runs verify-artifact.sh on authored Markdown and feeds broken-link findings back to Claude (it self-filters to *.md and fails open). Hook entries also accept an `if` field (permission-rule syntax, e.g. "if": "Edit(*.md)") to narrow when they fire. guard-dangerous-bash.sh is a PreToolUse Bash guard that hard-blocks the CLAUDE.md §4 non-negotiables (terraform/tofu auto-approve, --no-verify, force-push to main/master/develop) by exiting 2; it tokenizes with shlex so flags are told apart from quoted text, and fails open.

permissions.$comment: Allow common read/edit operations without prompting. Write/Edit are allowed deliberately: a sub-agent spawned to author files must never block on a write-approval prompt - a blocked write produces no output and hangs the whole pass (see lessons/2026 LESSON-0001). Spawn writing sub-agents with mode acceptEdits or rely on this allow-list. Anything writing to a shared system (push, terraform apply, slack) still prompts. The fork-bomb deny rule was removed: `Bash(:(){ :|:& };:)` is rejected by the permission-rule parser ("Empty parentheses") and was SKIPPED, so it never blocked anything. Fork bombs and the other CLAUDE.md §4 non-negotiables are enforced by scripts/guard-dangerous-bash.sh (PreToolUse, exit 2).
